text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Super Mario Bros. X Tech is a community-driven continuation and enhancement of the Super Mario Bros. X engine. It focuses on expanding the original fan-made platforming framework with improved tools, compatibility, scripting features, and technical improvements. The engine allows users to create custom Mario-style adventures using familiar characters, objects, and gameplay mechanics while providing additional features for level designers and developers.
